messages:
nina-customer: Hey support — we're seeing SCIM provision failures and intermittent 403s on the Deployments API. Also some users can't complete SAML login after our IdP cert rotation. Audit logs missing SCIM events for some orgs (org_id: org_7q3). Repro: run full SCIM sync from admin UI -> 500. Sometimes API returns {"error":"decrypt_failed"}. Suspect KMS/HSM issue, can you triage?

jen-support: Thanks — can you share the exact error body and the approximate time this started? Also: are you using BYOK or Redwood-managed keys? Can you run this quick repro from a shell and paste the output?

jen-support: ```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/internal/scim/sync 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"org_id":"org_7q3","mode":"full"}'
```

nina-customer: Ran it at 2026-03-16T19:20:42Z. Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Body: {"error":"decrypt_failed","message":"KMS decrypt failure"}
Log snippet from app: ```[2026-03-16T19:20:42Z] ERROR scim.sync: kms.decrypt() failed key_id=ak-9f3b... error=ERR_HSM_PROTOCOL```

akash-eng: We observed a short window of KMS HSM errors around 19:18Z during an HSM rotation — fallback to software decrypt didn't fully engage for some tenants. Quick checks: confirm whether org_7q3 uses BYOK (customer-managed) or Redwood-managed key. If BYOK and key was rotated in external HSM, the external endpoint may have been briefly unreachable.

akash-eng: Immediate workaround: if you can switch the tenant to Redwood-managed key for the sync (console -> Security -> Key management -> Use Redwood key) we can unblock provisioning. Also try forcing sync via API: ```POST /v1/admin/scim/sync?force=true {"org_id":"org_7q3"}```

sam-billing: Noted a spike in token calls and retries from org_7q3 starting 19:15Z — likely from automated retry loops. We'll flag for billing adjustment (possible credit) if the client was impacted by our outage. I'll create a billing ticket and tag here.

marie-security: One more ask: audit/log retention for org_7q3 — are we missing events or are events encrypted and failing to decrypt at ingestion? If events were written but can't be decrypted due to key rotation, they'll be ingested but not queryable. Please capture key_id from logs (looks like ak-9f3b...) and run key status: ```GET /v1/kms/keys/ak-9f3b.../status```

infra-bot: ALERT: INCIDENT-2026-03-16-KMS-ROTATION detected. Affected services: kms.decrypt, scim.sync. Severity: P2. Incident channel: #incidents.

jen-support: I've opened an internal incident (INC-3098) and assigned to eng-kms. Escalating to oncall and HSM vendor. akash-eng, can you own follow-up and post estimated ETA?

akash-eng: On it — I'll pull HSM vendor logs, confirm whether the external key endpoint returned 5xx or TCP timeouts, and verify fallback logic. ETA initial findings 30m. If fallback failed, we'll patch immediate workaround to force software decrypt and re-run sync.

nina-customer: Thanks — we'll try the Redwood-managed key switch and report results. Appreciate the quick response. :pray:
